simple.meaning: בָּרַר (bârar) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to clarify (i.e. brighten ), examine , select.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 18 times across 2 Samuel, 1 Chronicles, Nehemiah, Job, Psalms, and 6 more, beginning at 2 Samuel 22:27. Its contexts include family.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בָּרַר (H1305).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: בָּרַר (bârar) / H1305 is traced through 2 Samuel 22:27, 1 Chronicles 7:40, 1 Chronicles 9:22, 1 Chronicles 16:41 as a generated source-based concept entry.

timeline.evidenceText: With the pure you will show yourself pure.
With the pure you will show yourself pure.

All these were the children of Asher, heads of the fathers’ houses, choice and mighty men of valor, chief of the princes. The number of them listed by genealogy for service in war was twenty-six thousand men.

All these who were chosen to be gatekeepers in the thresholds were two hundred twelve. These were listed by genealogy in their villages, whom David and Samuel the seer ordained in their office of trust.
and with them Heman and Jeduthun, and the rest who were chosen, who were mentioned by name, to give thanks to Yahweh, because his loving kindness endures forever;

Now that which was prepared for one day was one ox and six choice sheep. Also fowls were prepared for me, and once in ten days a store of all sorts of wine. Yet for all this, I didn’t demand the governor’s pay, because the bondage was heavy on this people.
My words will utter the uprightness of my heart.
For you will save the afflicted people,
For you will save the afflicted people,
I said in my heart, “As for the sons of men, God tests them, so that they may see that they themselves are like animals.
He has made my mouth like a sharp sword.
Depart! Depart! Go out from there! Touch no unclean thing!
At that time it will be said to this people and to Jerusalem, “A hot wind from the bare heights in the wilderness toward the daughter of my people, not to winnow, nor to cleanse;

I will purge out from among you the rebels and those who disobey me. I will bring them out of the land where they live, but they shall not enter into the land of Israel. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.”
Some of those who are wise will fall, to refine them, and to purify, and to make them white, even to the time of the end; because it is yet for the time appointed.
Many will purify themselves, and make themselves white, and be refined; but the wicked will do wickedly; and none of the wicked will understand; but those who are wise will understand.
For then I will purify the lips of the peoples, that they may all call on Yahweh’s name, to serve him shoulder to shoulder.

definitions.usage: make bright, choice, chosen, cleanse (be clean), clearly, polished, (shew self) pure(-ify), purge (out).
definitions.full: H1305. barar [ בָּרַר ] verb purify, select (compare Assyrian barâru , be shining , in derivatives Zim BP 46. 73 Belser BAS ii. 154 ; Arabic pious, kind, true ; he was pious, good, virtuous, honest ) — Qal Perfect בָּרוֺתִי Ezek 20:38 ; Infinitive suffix לְבָרָם Eccl 3:18 , Ges § 67 R, 3; compare לָבוּר 9:1 (si vera lectio) as metaplastic form, but on text see בּוּר above; Participle passive masculine בָּרוּר Job 33:3-4 t.; feminine בְּרוּרָה Neh 5:18 ; Zeph 3:9 ; — 1 purge out, purify: הַמֹּרְדִים מִכֶּם וּבָרוֺתִי and I will purge out from among you the rebels Ezek 20:38 ; בְּרוּרָה שָׂפָה a purified lip Zeph 3:9 ; מִלֵּל֑וּ בָּרוּר utter in a pure, sincere manner Job 33:3 . 2 choose, select , only Participle and in Chronicler: chosen, valiant men 1Chr 7:40 ; porters 9:22 ; musicians 16:41 ; sheep Neh 5:18 . 3 cleanse, make shining, polish , passive participle בָּרוּר חֵץ polished arrow Isa 49:2 (compare De & Jer 51:11 below) 4 test, prove Eccl 3:18 הָאֱלֹהִים לְבָרָם that God may prove them (RV); — on 9:1 see בּוּר . Niph`al הִבָּרוּ Isa 52:11 ; Participle נָבָר 2Sam 22:27 (= Psa 18:27 ); — purify oneself: a. ceremonially, the bearers of the sacred vessels Isa 52:11 . b. morally 2Sam 22:27 = Psa 18:27 . Pi`el Infinitive לְבָרֵר Dan 11:35 purify (|| לַלְבֵּן לִצְרוֺף, ). Hiph`il 1. Infinitive לְהָבַר Jer 4:11 purify, cleanse. 2 Imperative הַחִצִּים הָבֵרוּ Jer 51:11 polish arrows (see 3 above). Hithpa`el 1. Imperfect יִתְבָּרֲרוּ Dan 12:10 purify oneself. 2 תִּתְבָּרַר Psa 18:27 = תִּתָּבָר 2Sam 22:27 shew oneself pure, just, kind.
